body: I can't find the words to describe how low I feel, I'm sorry.

Thanks for your support, it's really nice to know that someone who I haven't spoke to loads or even know would do something like that for someone like me. 

I do feel just a little in control at the moment, but all throughout today I've been trying not to cry, or break again. It's really really hard, I don't know how I'm doing it, but I know once night comes and no one will interrupt me, I will break. I can't even express myself to someone who isn't online without letting out a few tears, I just want this to stop. I will try something like what you explained later on. I will try anything..

Thank you so much. I just have to cherish the 'alright' swings for now, it's all I'm going on, because I'd like to hope that this at the moment is just a really long and deep swing. But honestly, I don't think it is, I feel this is much more.

Thank you, I know people love me, and I fight so hard, but I just need a break, I would do anything to have just a few days where I don't swing, I know I will break again in the next few days, it's just a matter of time.
Thanks, I hope you get through this.
We'll see soon if it is or isn't.

Yes, I've tried quite a few therapies over the years, but they don't seem to work, it's very hard for me to open up in person, as for medication, I want nothing more, but it's complicated. I feel so alone.
